_comment: THE CONTRACT BETWEEN THE TWO VIEWS OF ONE DEVICE: ITS AAS SHELL AND ITS i3X OBJECT.
Both are named from the device's sparkplug_id, each in its own process and language:
-- the shell, and the elementIds its i3X LinkedSegment names
-- the i3X object, whose metadata.system names its shell
Each asserts every case below in its own runner: the Deno tests (asset_identities_test.ts)
and the i3X unit suite (test_a_device_names_its_shell_and_carries_its_nameplate.py). A client
holding a shell and an i3X object matches them by these ids, so the two must give one answer.
`base_iri` is AAS_BASE_IRI as the chart sets it (supabaseFunctions.aas.baseIri). Its trailing
slashes become one, so a site that writes it with or without one names the same shells.
`metric` null is the device itself, whose elementId is its sparkplug_id.
Adding a case here is the way to extend the contract: both suites read every case.

cases.name: a metric whose name is a subtree
a base written without its slash
a base written with several slashes
